Name: Health and Stamina Regeneration
Author: JessebotX
Description:
Just a little gameplay mechanic improvement.

[size=6][u][b]Features[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*]Health and stamina regenerates overtime
[*]If you take damage/lose health, health regeneration goes on cooldown
[*]If you use stamina, stamina regeneration goes on cooldown
[*]Highly Configurable (See [url=https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewMods/tree/master/HealthStaminaRegen#configure][/url][url=https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewMods/tree/master/HealthStaminaRegen#configure]Configuration documentation[/url]﻿﻿﻿)
[/list]
[u][b][size=6]Install[/size][/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI (2.11 or higher)[/url]﻿
[*]Extract/Unzip zipped file into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[/list]
See [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide]Player's Guide to Downloading Mods[/url]﻿ if you are new to using mods or need help/

[b][u][size=6]Compatibility[/size][/u][/b]
See [url=https://mods.smapi.io/#Health_and_Stamina_Regeneration]if mod is up to date and compatible here[/url]

[list]
[*]Works in Singleplayer and Multiplayer [size=2](Only works for the person who has is installed it)[/size]
[*]No known mod conflicts [size=2](Report mod conflicts on the bugs/posts tab if you find any)[/size]
[/list]
